synth.notes:
Two-axis mirror board, 21x21 cells of 3x3 px (x=row). A5 cycles R axis -> C axis -> pieces; A1-4 move the selection one cell; moves that leave the board or overlap another piece are refused.
Pieces mirror across the C axis into visible solid grey cells. A piece with any cell on the R row has its whole C-mirror hidden (the step-268 fix; removing it fails only step 268). R- and RC-mirrors are always hidden.
Hidden cells erase wall rings. Hidden, piece and visible-mirror cells all mask targets down to the centre pixel. Paint order is wall < reflection < piece < target.
Re-extraction: walls/pieces are 4-connected groups of their own pixels plus all 0 pixels, and groups with only 0 pixels still use up an index. Wall is v if bbox w>=h. Reflection index counts hidden-cell groups too. Targets merge while the bbox gap is 4 or less.
Stateless. Unconfirmed: A5 order with more than 2 pieces, blocking at board edges and between pieces, behaviour when pieces touch and merge.
